Title: Legal Memo Summary
Description: Get a plain-language summary of a legal memo or opinion
Prompt Text: Summarize the following legal memo in plain language for a non-attorney audience, highlighting the key conclusion, reasoning, and any recommended next steps: {{paste memo text}}

Title: Performance Review Talking Points
Description: Prepare structured talking points for an upcoming performance conversation
Prompt Text: Help me prepare talking points for a performance review conversation with an employee whose strengths are {{strengths}} and growth areas are {{growth areas}}. Keep the tone constructive and specific.

Title: Interview Panel Notes Summary
Description: Summarize interview feedback captured across Word notes and Teams chat into one comparison
Prompt Text: Summarize the interview notes for {{candidate name}} across the Word documents and Teams chat feedback from the panel, and highlight areas of agreement and disagreement among interviewers.

Title: Explain a Benefits Policy
Description: Get a plain-language explanation of an HR or benefits policy to share with staff
Display Prompt: Explain this policy in plain language
Prompt Text: Explain the following HR policy in plain, employee-friendly language, and list three common questions employees might ask about it: {{paste policy text}}

Title: New Hire Welcome Email
Description: Draft a welcome email for incoming personnel using onboarding materials on file
Display Prompt: Draft a new hire welcome email
Prompt Text: Using the onboarding checklist and orientation schedule in my OneDrive or SharePoint, draft a welcome email for a new {{full-time, part-time, or seasonal}} employee starting on {{start date}}.

Title: Job Posting Draft
Description: Draft an external job posting for an open position
Prompt Text: Write a clear, inclusive job posting for a {{position title}} role in our {{division or office}}, including responsibilities, qualifications, and how to apply.

Title: Records Request Package Review
Description: Check an authorized draft package for completeness against a checklist
Prompt Text: Using the approved checklist {{checklist_file}} and the draft package {{package_file}}, create a completeness review showing each requirement, evidence location, missing item, and question for the records or legal team. Do not determine legal sufficiency or disclosure eligibility.

Title: Document Chronology
Description: Organize authorized matter documents without generating conclusions
Prompt Text: Using only the authorized files I select for {{matter_reference}}, create a chronology of documented events with date, event, source, document reference, stated follow-up, and unresolved discrepancy. Do not infer intent, assess credibility, or recommend action.

Title: After-Action Draft
Description: Structure an after-action review from approved records
Prompt Text: Using only the authorized records for {{event_or_exercise}}, draft an after-action review with objectives, sequence of events, what occurred as documented, decisions, coordination issues, lessons explicitly stated by participants, and action items. Do not assign blame or infer individual performance.

Title: Data Workbook Narrative
Description: Explain an authorized workbook without changing its data
Prompt Text: Analyze {{workbook_name}} and create a concise narrative of definitions, period covered, notable descriptive changes, missing or inconsistent values, and questions for the data owner. Cite sheet names and cell ranges. Do not infer causation or evaluate employee performance.

Title: Leadership Brief from Work Content
Description: Create a concise sourced brief from authorized internal material
Prompt Text: Using authorized work content about {{topic}} from {{time_period}}, create a one-page brief with situation, confirmed developments, decisions needed, risks, dependencies, and next actions. Cite every claim, separate facts from recommendations, and omit personal information not necessary for the decision.

Title: Community Engagement Recap
Description: Summarize authorized meeting inputs without profiling participants
Prompt Text: Using the authorized notes and files from {{community_meeting}}, summarize themes, factual requests, commitments, owners, due dates, and items requiring follow-up. Attribute only when the record explicitly requires it, avoid profiling participants, and cite each source.

Title: Change Communication Package
Description: Create coordinated internal communications from an approved plan
Prompt Text: Using the approved change plan {{file_name}}, draft an executive summary, employee announcement, manager talking points, and FAQ. Keep dates, scope, dependencies, and support contacts exactly aligned to the source, cite each section, and do not add promises.

Title: Technology Incident Timeline
Description: Build a factual timeline from authorized incident records
Prompt Text: Using the authorized incident emails, chats, meeting notes, and files for {{incident_name}}, build a chronological timeline with timestamp, event, source, action taken, owner if explicit, impact as reported, and remaining question. Do not infer root cause or assign blame.

Title: Recruiting Communication Draft
Description: Draft consistent candidate communication from approved sources
Prompt Text: Using only the approved recruiting guidance and templates in {{source_files}}, draft a message for {{candidate_stage}}. Preserve eligibility and process language, include only approved contact channels, use a respectful plain-language tone, and flag any requested statement not supported by the sources.

Title: Training Material Builder
Description: Turn approved internal material into a reusable learning asset
Prompt Text: Using only {{approved_source_files}}, create a 30-minute training outline for {{audience}} with objectives, agenda, key points, a demonstration or discussion activity, knowledge checks, and source citations. Preserve mandatory policy language and flag content that needs subject-matter review.

Title: Procurement Document Comparison
Description: Compare attached authorized procurement materials
Prompt Text: Compare the attached authorized documents for {{procurement_topic}} against the stated requirements. Build a compliance matrix with requirement, document response, evidence location, gap, and question for review. Do not score vendors, recommend selection, or infer compliance where evidence is absent.

Title: Project Status from Work Data
Description: Build a sourced status report from accessible content
Prompt Text: Using accessible emails, chats, meetings, and files for {{project_name}} during {{time_period}}, create a status report with completed work, current work, decisions, risks, blockers, owners, and next milestones. Cite every item and label any conflicting status reports.

Title: Policy Version Comparison
Description: Identify meaningful changes between two authorized documents
Prompt Text: Compare {{older_policy_file}} and {{newer_policy_file}}. Create a table of added, removed, and changed requirements with section references, effective-date language, and likely communications or training topics. Do not infer legal effect beyond the text.

Title: Internal Policy Q&A
Description: Answer a question from an authorized policy source
Prompt Text: Answer this question using only the current authorized policy file I specify: {{question}}. Cite the exact section, quote only the minimum necessary text, state the document date or version, and say “not addressed in the cited policy” when applicable. Do not provide legal advice.

Title: Draft Reply from Thread Context
Description: Draft a response grounded only in the selected conversation
Prompt Text: Using only the selected email thread {{email_subject}}, draft a concise reply that acknowledges the request, answers only questions supported by the thread, confirms my explicit commitments, and lists unresolved items. Do not add commitments, dates, or facts.

Title: Email Thread Decision Summary
Description: Reduce a long authorized email thread to decisions and next steps
Prompt Text: Summarize the email thread {{email_subject}} into background, confirmed decisions, requested actions, owners, dates, disagreements, and unanswered questions. Cite the specific messages and distinguish current decisions from superseded proposals.

Title: Shift Handoff Draft
Description: Create a structured handoff from approved operational notes
Prompt Text: Using only the approved notes and files I attach for {{shift_or_date}}, draft a shift handoff with confirmed facts, active items, completed actions, pending follow-ups, owner, deadline, and unknowns. Preserve source wording for critical details, cite each item, and do not introduce recommendations or personal data not already provided.

Title: Meeting Decisions and Actions
Description: Extract decisions and follow-ups from a transcribed meeting
Prompt Text: From {{meeting_name}}, list decisions, action items, owners, due dates, unresolved questions, and risks. Cite the transcript or meeting source for every item. If an owner or due date was not explicitly stated, write “not assigned” or “not stated” rather than guessing.

Title: Meeting Preparation Pack
Description: Prepare for an upcoming internal meeting from authorized work content
Prompt Text: Prepare me for {{meeting_name}} using the invitation, related emails, chats, and files I can access. Summarize purpose, prior decisions, open questions, my commitments, and documents to review. Cite every source and flag items that may be outdated.

Title: Morning Work Priorities
Description: Turn authorized Microsoft 365 activity into a focused start-of-day plan
Prompt Text: Using my accessible emails, chats, meetings, and files from the past 3 business days, identify my top priorities for today. Group them as urgent, scheduled, waiting on others, and can defer. Cite each source, distinguish explicit commitments from suggestions, and do not infer priority solely from sender seniority.

Title: Public Meeting Minute Template
Description: Create a reusable, accessible public-meeting template
Prompt Text: Create an accessible meeting-minutes template for {{meeting_type}} with sections for date, purpose, attendees by role, agenda items, factual discussion summary, decisions, owners, due dates, public links, and unresolved questions. Include a reminder not to include sensitive or personal information.

Title: Public Spending Data Review
Description: Analyze an official public spending dataset descriptively
Prompt Text: Using the official public dataset at {{dataset_link}}, summarize spending by {{category_and_period}}, identify the largest descriptive variances, explain publisher-stated limitations, and provide source links. Do not infer waste, misconduct, or causation.

Title: Budget Terminology Explainer
Description: Explain public-sector budget concepts in plain language
Prompt Text: Create a plain-language explainer for {{budget_terms_or_process}} using official {{jurisdiction}} budget publications and government finance sources. Include definitions, where each item appears in the budget cycle, a simple example, and links.

Title: Workplace Policy FAQ
Description: Translate a published policy into neutral employee guidance
Prompt Text: Using only the official published policy at {{policy_link_or_text}}, create a 12-question employee FAQ. Cite the relevant section for each answer, preserve mandatory language, distinguish requirements from recommendations, and flag questions the policy does not answer.

Title: Supervisor Conversation Guide
Description: Draft a respectful non-evaluative check-in guide
Prompt Text: Draft a respectful conversation guide for a supervisor checking in with an employee after {{workplace_event_or_change}}. Include open-ended questions, privacy boundaries, available support-resource reminders, and documentation cautions. Do not infer the employee’s feelings, diagnose, or assess performance.

Title: Employee Wellness Resource Digest
Description: Compile official wellness resources for employees
Prompt Text: Using current official employer, public health, and employee assistance program (EAP) resources, create a confidential-use resource digest for {{wellness_topic}}. Include available services, eligibility as stated, access methods, emergency contacts, and links. Do not diagnose or request personal details.

Title: Tabletop Exercise Outline
Description: Create a non-tactical continuity exercise from public guidance
Prompt Text: Using public FEMA and CISA exercise guidance, draft a non-tactical tabletop exercise outline for {{business_continuity_scenario}}. Include objectives, roles, inject categories, decision logs, accessibility considerations, and an after-action template. Do not include sensitive facility details or adversary tactics.

Title: Emergency Preparedness Pack
Description: Assemble authoritative public resources for a preparedness topic
Prompt Text: Create a curated resource pack on {{hazard_or_emergency_topic}} using official FEMA, state and local emergency management, public health, and utility sources. Include before, during, and after guidance, accessibility and language-access resources, printable materials, and links.

Title: Infrastructure Standards Scan
Description: Research public resilience standards at a high level
Prompt Text: Research current public standards and government guidance relevant to resilience of {{infrastructure_type}}. Summarize governance, risk assessment, continuity, cybersecurity, and exercise considerations at a high level. Do not identify site-specific vulnerabilities or provide attack-enabling detail.

Title: Preparedness Guidance Digest
Description: Summarize public preparedness guidance
Prompt Text: Using current official DHS, CISA, FEMA, and state and local emergency management public guidance on {{preparedness_topic}}, create a concise digest for awareness training. Include observable safety guidance, reporting channels, accessibility considerations, and source links. Exclude tactical vulnerabilities and response procedures.

Title: Public Dashboard QA Checklist
Description: Review a public dashboard for clarity and traceability
Prompt Text: Review the public dashboard at {{dashboard_link}} for clear definitions, date labeling, source attribution, accessibility, filter behavior, downloadable data, and stated limitations. Return a numbered QA checklist with evidence from the page. Do not assess employee performance.

Title: Data Definition Crosswalk
Description: Reconcile definitions across public datasets
Prompt Text: Compare how the official sources {{source_list}} define {{metric_or_category}}. Create a crosswalk of definitions, inclusion criteria, exclusions, reporting periods, and known limitations. Explain why the figures may not be directly comparable without declaring one source correct.

Title: Public Data Trend Context
Description: Describe published aggregate trends without prediction
Prompt Text: Using official aggregate statistics for {{topic_geography_and_period}}, describe changes over time, category definitions, data limitations, and relevant public context. Use counts and rates exactly as published, avoid causal claims or predictions, and provide source links.

Title: Policy Topic Primer
Description: Build a lawful public-source primer for training
Prompt Text: Create a neutral primer on {{policy_topic}} using public statutes, court publications, government guidance, and academic research. Cover terminology, documented trends, legal or privacy issues described by sources, and questions for legal or policy review. Do not provide operational instructions.

Title: Community Services Resource Guide
Description: Compile public support resources without case-specific advice
Prompt Text: Create a current, trauma-informed directory of official and established nonprofit support resources for {{need_or_area}}. Include service type, eligibility as stated, hours, language access, accessibility, contact information, and source link. Do not ask for or include case details.

Title: Youth Program Directory
Description: Compile current official youth opportunities
Prompt Text: Using current official government and recognized nonprofit sources, compile youth programs serving {{area_or_age_range}}. Include purpose, ages served, cost if stated, application period, accessibility or language services if stated, last verified date, and link. Exclude programs whose current status cannot be confirmed.

Title: Neighborhood Resource Map Plan
Description: Plan a public resource inventory without personal data
Prompt Text: Design a template for cataloging public resources in {{neighborhood}}. Include category, organization, address, hours, eligibility, language access, accessibility, last verified date, and source link. Then identify official directories that can populate it. Do not collect personal data.

Title: Tenant Resource Guide Draft
Description: Create a sourced directory of public services
Prompt Text: Create a plain-language resource guide for residents in {{area}} using official government sources. Include emergency and non-emergency contacts, housing services, domestic violence resources, youth services, mental health resources, language access, and accessibility services. Verify every phone number and link.

Title: Housing Development Context Brief
Description: Research public context for a housing location
Prompt Text: Using official housing authority, housing agency, community board, and open data sources, create a public-context brief for {{development_or_area}}. Cover public facilities, announced projects, community meetings, and published quality-of-life resources. Do not profile residents or infer risk.

Title: Service Change Advisory
Description: Draft a neutral public-facing advisory from approved facts
Prompt Text: Using only these approved facts: {{approved_service_facts}}, draft a public-facing advisory with what is changing, where, when, expected public impact, available alternatives stated in the facts, accessibility information, and official contact channels. Do not add operational details.

Title: Traffic Safety Resource Digest
Description: Summarize current public safety guidance and programs
Prompt Text: Using current official city, county, state DOT, and federal (NHTSA and FHWA) sources, summarize public programs and guidance related to {{traffic_safety_topic}}. Organize by audience, available resource, eligibility if stated, and source link.

Title: Traffic Safety Data Context
Description: Explain a public traffic-safety dataset
Prompt Text: Using the public dataset at {{dataset_link}}, explain the fields, coverage period, update frequency, limitations stated by the publisher, and notable descriptive patterns for {{location_or_period}}. Do not infer causation or identify individuals. Provide reproducible filtering steps in plain language.

Title: Fleet Technology Scan
Description: Research publicly documented vehicle and fleet technologies
Prompt Text: Research current public information on {{fleet_technology}} for large municipal fleets. Compare stated capabilities, maintenance considerations, interoperability, accessibility, cybersecurity documentation, and public-sector deployments. Treat vendor claims as claims and include source dates.

Title: Records Retention Research
Description: Summarize published retention requirements for counsel review
Prompt Text: Using current official state, local, and applicable federal public guidance for {{record_category}}, summarize published retention periods, triggering events, exceptions, and source links. Highlight conflicts or ambiguity for records-management and legal review. Do not provide legal advice.

Title: Policy Comparison Matrix
Description: Compare published policies across jurisdictions
Prompt Text: Compare official published policies from {{jurisdictions_or_agencies}} on {{policy_topic}}. Build a matrix of scope, definitions, mandates, exceptions, oversight, reporting, and effective dates. Link each source and leave cells blank where the policy does not specify an item.

Title: Public Records Research Plan
Description: Plan efficient research across public sources
Prompt Text: Create a research plan for the question {{research_question}} using only public sources. Prioritize primary records, list exact search terms, identify likely custodians or repositories, define inclusion and exclusion criteria, and provide a verification checklist. Do not claim that records have been found.

Title: Accessibility Review Checklist
Description: Create a checklist from current public accessibility standards
Prompt Text: Using current WCAG, Section 508, and applicable state or local digital accessibility guidance, create a practical review checklist for {{website_document_or_application}}. Cite the requirement behind each check and separate mandatory criteria from recommended usability practices.

Title: Vendor Documentation Navigator
Description: Find authoritative setup and support documentation
Prompt Text: Locate the current official documentation for {{product_and_task}}. Return a concise map of prerequisites, supported versions, configuration references, troubleshooting references, lifecycle notices, and direct links. Do not invent steps not stated in the documentation.

Title: Technology Standards Comparison
Description: Compare public technical standards without selecting a solution
Prompt Text: Compare {{standard_or_protocol_A}} and {{standard_or_protocol_B}} using current standards-body and vendor-neutral documentation. Provide scope, security properties, dependencies, interoperability considerations, lifecycle status, and source links. Clearly identify items that require environment-specific testing.

Title: Cybersecurity Advisory Digest
Description: Summarize official public cyber advisories
Prompt Text: Using current CISA, MS-ISAC, vendor, and CVE sources, summarize public advisories relevant to {{technology_or_product}} during {{time_period}}. Include affected versions, severity as stated by the source, known exploitation status, mitigations quoted or paraphrased from official guidance, and links. Do not claim whether our agency is affected.

Title: AI Use Case Risk Screen
Description: Structure an initial review of a proposed AI use case
Prompt Text: Using the proposed use case {{use_case}} and only public guidance from NIST, government, and recognized standards bodies, create an initial risk-question checklist covering purpose, data, human oversight, accuracy, bias testing, security, transparency, records obligations, and failure modes. This is a planning aid, not approval or legal advice.

Title: Emerging Technology Primer
Description: Explain an emerging technology for a nontechnical audience
Prompt Text: Create a neutral, sourced primer on {{technology}} for public-sector staff. Cover what it is, typical uses, limitations, privacy and security considerations reported by authoritative sources, relevant standards, and questions to ask before adoption. Do not recommend deployment.

Title: Peer Agency Practice Scan
Description: Research published practices from comparable agencies
Prompt Text: Research how comparable US state and local government agencies publicly describe their approach to {{topic}}. Compare stated goals, governance, implementation approach, published measures, and source dates. Use primary sources where available and clearly label vendor-authored claims.

Title: Grant Opportunity Scan
Description: Find relevant public grant opportunities
Prompt Text: Search current official federal, state, and local grant sources for opportunities related to {{program_goal}}. Return a table with sponsor, program, eligible applicants, stated funding range, deadline, match requirement, and official link. Exclude closed opportunities and flag items whose eligibility requires confirmation.

Title: Public Contract Benchmark
Description: Compare public contracts and pricing structures
Prompt Text: Find publicly available state or municipal contracts for {{product_or_service}}. Summarize contract scope, pricing model, term, procurement vehicle, and public link. Note material differences that prevent direct comparison and do not estimate missing prices.

Title: Procurement Market Scan
Description: Research publicly available product and vendor information
Prompt Text: Conduct a neutral public-web market scan for {{product_or_service_category}}. Compare at least five vendors using only published information for capabilities, standards, public-sector references, accessibility statements, security documentation, contract vehicles if publicly listed, and source dates. Do not recommend a winner or treat marketing claims as verified.

Title: Public Research Reading List
Description: Build a credible learning path on a job-relevant topic
Prompt Text: Create a prioritized reading list on {{topic}} for {{audience}} using current official, academic, and recognized professional sources. Include beginner, intermediate, and advanced sections, a one-sentence reason for each selection, publication date, and link. Exclude paywalled sources when a credible public alternative exists.

Title: Scenario-Based Knowledge Check
Description: Turn approved material into a low-risk practice activity
Prompt Text: Using only this approved training content: {{approved_training_text}}, create eight scenario-based multiple-choice questions. Provide the correct answer and a brief rationale tied to the supplied text. Do not introduce operational tactics, legal conclusions, or policy not present in the source.

Title: Training Topic Research
Description: Build a sourced primer for instructors
Prompt Text: Create a sourced primer on {{training_topic}} using official government, academic, and recognized standards-body sources. Include core concepts, common misconceptions, a glossary, five knowledge-check questions, and links. Separate established guidance from emerging practices.

Title: Career Fair Outreach Draft
Description: Create an inclusive invitation from approved event facts
Prompt Text: Using these approved event details: {{event_details}}, draft three versions of a career-fair invitation for email, web, and a short social post. Keep eligibility statements exactly aligned to the official source, use inclusive plain language, and include a clear call to action.

Title: Recruiting FAQ Research
Description: Compile current public recruiting requirements
Prompt Text: Using current official agency and civil service employment pages, create a candidate FAQ for {{role}} covering published eligibility, exam or application steps, required documents, process stages, and official contact links. State the page date or last-updated date when available and flag any conflicting guidance.

Title: Press Question Preparation
Description: Anticipate factual questions from public reporting
Prompt Text: Review current public reporting and official releases about {{topic}}. Generate 15 likely factual questions a reporter may ask, grouped by confirmed facts, timeline, public impact, and next steps. For each, identify the public source that prompted the question. Do not draft answers or speculate.

Title: Media Coverage Comparison
Description: Compare how credible outlets describe the same public event
Prompt Text: Compare coverage of {{topic_or_event}} from at least five credible sources published during {{time_period}}. Create a table of confirmed facts, differing emphasis, claims requiring verification, corrections or updates, and source links. Do not speculate about motives or label sentiment.

Title: Multilingual Message Preparation
Description: Prepare text for professional translation and review
Prompt Text: Rewrite the following approved public message in plain English at approximately an eighth-grade reading level, then create a translation-ready glossary for names, addresses, acronyms, and terms that must remain unchanged: {{message}}. Do not translate the message; prepare it for a qualified language-access review.

Title: Plain-Language Public Notice
Description: Rewrite approved facts for broad public understanding
Prompt Text: Using only these approved public facts: {{approved_facts}}, draft a public notice for a general public audience. Use plain language, short sentences, clear action steps, accessibility-friendly headings, and a calm factual tone. Do not add facts, names, or promises.

Title: Resident FAQ Draft
Description: Create clear answers to common public questions
Prompt Text: Draft a plain-language FAQ for residents about {{program_event_or_service_topic}}. Use only the official public sources I provide or current official government sources. Include 10 questions, concise answers, eligibility or limitations explicitly stated in sources, contact channels, and links. Mark any answer that requires agency confirmation.

Title: Community Meeting Agenda Builder
Description: Draft a resident-focused agenda using public context
Prompt Text: Using public information about {{district_or_neighborhood}} and the topics {{topics}}, draft a 45-minute community meeting agenda. Include objectives, timed sections, neutral discussion questions, an accessibility and language-access check, and a closing resource section. Do not include nonpublic or personal information.

Title: Legislative Hearing Digest
Description: Summarize public testimony and hearing materials
Prompt Text: Using official hearing pages, agendas, testimony, and video or transcripts for {{hearing_topic_and_date}}, summarize the positions presented, points of agreement, disputed issues, and requested follow-ups. Attribute each position and include source links.

Title: Court Decision Research Brief
Description: Summarize a published court decision without giving legal advice
Prompt Text: Using the official published opinion for {{case_name_or_citation}} and reputable legal summaries, create a neutral research brief: issue presented, holding, reasoning, effective status, and questions for agency counsel. Distinguish the court’s language from commentary and include source links. Do not provide legal advice.

Title: Public Law Update Explainer
Description: Explain a newly published law or rule in plain language
Prompt Text: Using the official enacted text and current government guidance for {{law_rule_or_policy}}, explain the change in plain language. Identify effective date, covered parties, key requirements, exceptions explicitly stated in the source, and unresolved questions. Quote only short necessary phrases and link to the primary sources. This is an informational summary, not legal advice.

Title: Street Closure Research
Description: Compile publicly announced street closures and traffic restrictions
Prompt Text: Using current official transportation department, emergency management, and event-organizer sources, list publicly announced street closures or traffic restrictions for {{area}} during {{date_and_time}}. Include location, effective time, stated reason, and source link. Do not suggest operational tactics.

Title: Transit Service Impact Scan
Description: Summarize public transit changes that may affect staffing or public movement
Prompt Text: Using official transit agency service status and planned-work sources, summarize current and upcoming disruptions affecting {{area_or_lines}} during {{time_period}}. Organize by subway, bus, and commuter rail where relevant, cite every item, and note when each source was last updated.

Title: Weather Impact Brief
Description: Translate official weather information into a concise planning brief
Prompt Text: Using current National Weather Service and state or local emergency management public information for {{date_or_period}}, create a concise planning brief for {{county_city_or_region}}. Include timing, expected conditions, official watches or warnings, likely transportation impacts stated by official sources, and links. Do not invent staffing recommendations.

Title: Public Event Planning Snapshot
Description: Create a public-information snapshot for an upcoming event
Prompt Text: Research {{event_name}} on {{event_date}} using official organizer, city or county, transit agency, transportation department, and weather sources. Produce a planning snapshot covering public schedule, location, announced street or transit impacts, forecast, accessibility considerations, and source links. Clearly label anything not confirmed by an official source.

Title: Daily Public Affairs News Scan
Description: Scan credible public sources for developments relevant to the agency
Prompt Text: Using current public web sources, summarize today’s developments relevant to {{jurisdiction_or_program_area}} across public safety, transportation, weather, major events, and city operations. Separate confirmed facts from analysis, include publication dates and source links, flag conflicting reports, and end with five items a supervisor should monitor. Do not include rumors or infer operational decisions.

Title: Records Request Volume Analysis
Description: Analyze a spreadsheet of records requests to identify volume trends
Prompt Text: Analyze the request log in {{Excel file name}} and summarize monthly request volume trends over the last {{time period}}, noting any unusual spikes.

Title: Request Denial Explanation Draft
Description: Draft plain-language wording explaining why a request was denied or partially fulfilled
Prompt Text: Draft plain-language wording explaining that a records request was {{denied or partially fulfilled}} due to {{general reason category}}, in a professional and respectful tone.

Title: Open Records Request Tracker
Description: Summarize open records requests from a SharePoint list by age and status
Prompt Text: Summarize the open requests in {{SharePoint list name}} grouped by status and days open, and flag any approaching a response deadline.

Title: Explain Records Retention Rules
Description: Get a plain-language explanation of a records retention schedule
Prompt Text: Explain the following records retention rule in plain language, including what it means for staff day to day: {{paste rule text}}

Title: Records Request Acknowledgment
Description: Draft a standard acknowledgment letter for a records request
Prompt Text: Draft a standard acknowledgment letter confirming receipt of a records request dated {{date}}, including an estimated response timeframe of {{timeframe}}.

Title: Workplace Safety Week Plan
Description: Brainstorm a simple weeklong workplace safety awareness campaign for staff
Prompt Text: Suggest a five-day workplace safety awareness campaign for staff covering topics like {{example topics}}, with one simple activity per day.

Title: Weekly Service Request Summary
Description: Summarize service request records into a weekly briefing for leadership
Prompt Text: Summarize the service requests saved in {{SharePoint folder or list name}} for this week into a short briefing organized by location and priority, without including requester names or personal details.

Title: Training Reminder Email
Description: Draft a reminder email about upcoming required training
Prompt Text: Draft a short reminder email to staff about the upcoming {{training name}} training on {{date}}, including what to bring and where to report.

Title: Simplify a Safety Plan
Description: Rewrite a safety plan into simple steps staff can follow
Prompt Text: Rewrite the following safety plan into simple, numbered steps that staff without safety training could follow: {{paste plan text}}

Title: Public Notification Letter
Description: Draft a clear, reassuring letter to residents about a service or safety matter
Prompt Text: Draft a clear, reassuring letter to residents about {{topic}}, explaining what happened at a high level, what's being done, and who to contact with questions.

Title: Supervisor Shift Briefing
Description: Pull recent updates from a Teams channel into a short supervisor briefing
Display Prompt: Build a shift briefing from Teams updates
Prompt Text: Summarize the last 24 hours of posts in the {{Teams channel name}} channel into a short briefing for an incoming supervisor.

Title: Overtime Request Email
Description: Draft a professional email requesting or documenting overtime approval
Prompt Text: Draft a professional email requesting approval for {{number}} hours of overtime on {{date}} for {{reason}}.

Title: Daily Activity Summary
Description: Summarize a shared activity log spreadsheet into a shift summary
Prompt Text: Summarize the entries in {{Excel or SharePoint list name}} for {{date or shift}} into a short narrative summary a supervisor could read in under a minute.

Title: Shift Change Memo
Description: Draft a memo communicating a schedule or shift change
Prompt Text: Draft a memo informing personnel about the following schedule change: {{describe change}}, including the effective date and who to contact with questions.

Title: Team Briefing Announcement
Description: Draft a short announcement to be read or posted at a team briefing
Prompt Text: Draft a short, clear announcement for a team briefing about {{topic}}, no more than 100 words, in a direct and professional tone.

Title: Report Proofreading
Description: Proofread and tighten a report for clarity and consistency
Prompt Text: Proofread the following report for grammar, clarity, and consistency, and suggest edits without changing the substance: {{paste report text}}

Title: Status Email Summary
Description: Summarize a thread of status update emails into a single overview
Prompt Text: Summarize my email thread with subject {{subject line}} into a short overview of current status, open questions, and next steps.

Title: Constituent Follow-Up Letter
Description: Draft a neutral, professional follow-up letter to a constituent or requester
Prompt Text: Draft a neutral, professional letter following up with {{constituent or requester}} regarding {{general purpose}}, without including sensitive personal details.

Title: Field Notes to Report Format
Description: Reformat rough field notes from Word into a standardized report structure
Display Prompt: Format these notes into a report
Prompt Text: Reformat the notes in {{document name}} into our standard report structure with clear sections and consistent formatting, without altering the factual content.
